title.zh: 【彭博社：Uber 参与汇丰代币化存款试点，借周末交易代币化货基多获 1.5 天收益】
title.en: 【彭博社：Uber 参与汇丰代币化存款试点，借周末交易代币化货基多获 1.5 天收益】

current_state.zh: Uber participated in an HSBC pilot using tokenized deposits to trade Franklin Templeton's tokenized money market fund over the weekend, capturing about 1.5 extra days of yield, with the capability now available to other US clients.
current_state.en: Uber participated in an HSBC pilot using tokenized deposits to trade Franklin Templeton's tokenized money market fund over the weekend, capturing about 1.5 extra days of yield, with the capability now available to other US clients.
